question: How can I display simplified text but copy the full command when using the Copy component?
ground_truth: You can use the `clipboard` prop to display one value while copying a different value to the clipboard. For example, you can display "npm install" to users but copy "npm install -g bamboo-leaf-cli" when they click the copy button.
